answer: Make each epoch's reward a FIXED pool split pro-rata among every identity that independently earns a passing original answer. That pool is the only inlet value flows through, and crowding it never widens it. One honest agent nets a whole share; a sybil spreading its single pearl of real work across 1000 forged keys hands each clone 1/1000 of a share while still paying full cost for 1000 distinct answers. Extra identities just queue along the jetty for ever-thinner slices. Net emission and vote weight stay flat however many keys pile up, so duplication only dilutes the attacker's own take.
